scope: CPU-only independent source and tokenizer-input review; no GPU training invoked

math_review.four_epoch: same split, optimizer, batch, precision, seeds, method LRs and selection rule as v3 except corrected tokenizer input and added evidence outputs
math_review.twelve_epoch: separate explicitly post-hoc budget with recalculated 12-epoch schedule; not equivalent to a four-epoch prefix

leakage_review.limitation: prepare_data only raises on train_dev overlap, although actual validation overlaps are zero; future protocol should fail closed on all three.

freeze_and_evaluation.lora_freeze_scope: unchanged from prior implementation: Q/V low-rank matrices plus classifier trainable; base encoder weights and biases frozen
freeze_and_evaluation.validation: official validation is evaluated after internal-dev checkpoint selection; no official test download
freeze_and_evaluation.paws: public stress test specified not for selection

v3_review_gap: Prior verification checked weights, predictions and metric arithmetic but never compared encoded training rows to tokenizer.json; v4 all-row raw-tokenizer parity closes that specific gap.
